p: Sheba heard of the fame of: Josephus says that she was Queen of Ethiopia, and that Sheba was the name of the chief city of Meroe, which is an island of the Nile.
meat of his table: That is, the whole order, and trade of his house.
wisdom: But much more happy are they, who hear the wisdom of God revealed in his word.
delighted in thee: It is a chief sign of God's favour, when godly and wise rulers fit in the throne of justice.
judgment and justice: This is the reason kings are appointed.
country: That is, Arabia, which for the great abundance of all things was called Happy.
stays on either side on the: As the chair bows, or places to lean upon.
Tharshish: By Tharshish is meant Cilicia, which was abundant in the variety of precious things.
